mentions.name: Visirya
mentions.description: This app helps people record their night dreams and transforms them into short videos and written journals. Its larger goal is to use dream data to create dream cartographies—maps of recurring themes, emotions, and symbols—to uncover patterns and insights across dreams over time. Video generation and dream journaling are already built, the app is live on TestFlight, and an upcoming update adds a new UI plus a dream questionnaire to support pattern recognition and dream mapping.
mentions.audience: People looking to record their night dreams
